description: This Java interface defines a factory for creating field expressions used in querying 'things' within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides default methods for generating filter, existence, and sort expressions based on namespaces, feature IDs, feature properties, attributes, and thing IDs.

classes.name: ThingsFieldExpressionFactory
classes.description: An interface extending FieldExpressionFactory, providing default methods to create various field expressions for querying 'things' based on namespace, feature, attribute, and thing ID.

methods.name: filterByNamespace
methods.description: Creates a filter expression for the namespace.

methods.name: existsByFeatureId
methods.description: Creates an existence expression for a specific feature ID.

methods.name: filterByFeatureProperty
methods.description: Creates a filter expression for a specific feature property.

methods.name: existsByFeatureProperty
methods.description: Creates an existence expression for a specific feature property.

methods.name: sortByFeatureProperty
methods.description: Creates a sort expression for a specific feature property.

methods.name: filterByAttribute
methods.description: Creates a filter expression for a specific attribute.

methods.name: existsByAttribute
methods.description: Creates an existence expression for a specific attribute.

methods.name: sortByAttribute
methods.description: Creates a sort expression for a specific attribute.

methods.name: filterByThingId
methods.description: Creates a filter expression for the thing ID.

methods.name: sortByThingId
methods.description: Creates a sort expression for the thing ID.
